floating_rate_quote: All other long-term debt is at fixed interest rates and, therefore, is not affected by changes in interest rates. ... There were no outstanding borrowings under the revolving credit facility as of January 31, 2026.
floating_rate_basis: All long-term debt is fixed rate. The $1.5B revolver is SOFR-based but undrawn at January 31, 2026 ($290M drawn a year earlier). $425M of 2021 notes carry rating-linked coupon step-ups, already triggered; that is a fixed-rate repricing, not floating exposure.
